Markus —

Appreciate the heads-up. Short answer: we can cover a VP-level sponsor slot, but our CTO (Marcus) is not available between 10–11 PT that day. I'd like to propose two practical options so Rajiv gets the right signal without blocking Marcus's calendar:

1) Marcus (Director-level) leads the first 20 and I join as exec sponsor; Marcus will follow up with a 15-minute deep-dive the next day if needed.
2) Marcus calls in for the first 10 minutes to greet Rajiv, then I take the bulk of the briefing as exec sponsor.

I can do a 20-minute pre-brief with Rajiv/Tara an hour before the slot if that helps. Which do you prefer?

Best,
